regime_context: Detector shows Banks as the dominant, crowded, one-narrative theme (durability 0.74, breadth 0.833, eligible). Crucially, backtest_verdict says the absolute-trend gate did NOT hold on this China A-shares history (gate_helps=false) and rank-IC is weak, so this is a focus/flow lens with no validated forward edge here. Rotation breadth is narrow (2/22 eligible, frac 0.09), absorption 0.37, and no confirmed handoff — a fragile single-leader tape.
emerging_watch: Coal (rank 2, score 0.51, but ineligible with durability_bar 0.2 and breadth 0.1) — watching whether it crosses to eligible AND durability separates above the current leader's durability while Banks' breadth falters; that combination would signal a potential confirmed handoff toward a Cyclicals & Resources leadership, but only with the gate clearing on a sustained trend tag.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks is the only theme that is simultaneously trend-tagged, high-durability (0.74), broad (0.833), and eligible under the absolute-trend gate. It is even stronger in cohort text (SOE Blue Chips also crowded at 0.87 durability) — indicating a cohesive Financials & Value leadership. This is a trend-following lean toward existing leadership, not a prediction that it will outperform.
theses.dissent: Banks is crowded (z=1.72) with one_narrative=true; in China A-shares crowding/attention often marks tops. The backtest verdict explicitly says the absolute-trend gate did NOT reduce drawdown on this market, so the trend follow has no historical protection here. Absorption is low (0.37), meaning the theme is not absorbing cross-sectional flow — it may be a slow grind at risk of a sharp mean-reverting unwind.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS lags CSI 300 by 3% over any rolling 10-day window before the check-by horizon

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma is technically eligible (true) and rank 5, but it is crowded (z=1.38) with mixed hurst tag and middling breadth (0.5), sitting well below the dominant Banks theme in score. The eligibility appears weak relative to its crowding. No basis to lean overweight a crowded, mid-table theme when the only validated edge here is null.
theses.dissent: Pharma is one of the few eligible themes and not as crowded as Medical Devices (z=2.2). If the macro backdrop shifts toward domestic innovation/industrial_policy (already present in macro_narrative), Pharma could rotate in as the confirmed handoff from Banks.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ takes the rank-1 spot with durability above 0.7 and crowding_z retreating below 1.0 before the check-by horizon

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
